intro: Elune's Grace is a rite of recognition offered to devout night elf priests in Darnassus. Upon proving their faith and discipline through their early journeys, priests are called before Priestess Alathea to receive deeper instruction in the divine mysteries of the Moon Goddess.

clips.title: Completion
paras: By devoting yourself to Elune and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?
